title: 10.1 Sequences

icans: I can write terms of a sequence from its formula.
I can find the limit of a sequence, or tell that it diverges.
I can decide whether a sequence is monotonic and bounded.

vocab: a ___________ whose domain is the positive integers: a₁, a₂, a₃, …
a sequence whose terms ___________ a single number L
